scope: Native Leptos server-function adapter for the authenticated-user grouped notification inbox storefront port

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

notifications_local_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the owner-local implementation ledger without replacing the large file wholesale

notifications_owner_docs_sync.follow_up: Safely revise the large owner README and live contract statements that still describe external transport as closed

policy.request_identity_boundary: native request DTOs contain no tenant recipient or user identity field
policy.authentication: every endpoint extracts AuthContext before owner access
policy.principal_kind: OAuth service principals are rejected and human-user identity is mapped through AuthContext port_actor
policy.tenant_scope: every endpoint extracts TenantContext and rejects auth tenant mismatch
policy.request_context: locale and correlation context derive from RequestContext
policy.recipient_scope: recipient actor derives only from the authenticated human-user principal
policy.read_admission: unread count group summaries group items and open authorization carry a five-second deadline
policy.write_admission: group state carries a five-second deadline and caller-supplied idempotency key
policy.claim_context: authenticated permissions become PortContext claims and channel is storefront
policy.open_validation_order: authentication and tenant admission occur before notification UUID parsing
policy.runtime_registry: the adapter reuses Arc NotificationSourceRegistry from HostRuntimeContext
policy.runtime_policy: the adapter reuses NotificationRecipientPolicyRuntime from HostRuntimeContext
policy.owner_delegation: all operations delegate to NotificationInboxStorefrontService and its existing owner services
policy.error_boundary: missing runtime values share one unavailable message and owner PortError messages are already sanitized
policy.dto_mapping: UUID route and timestamp values use strings while state priority and actions use local snake-case enums
policy.host_composition: the existing application storefront ssr feature enables the notification storefront ssr feature
policy.ui_boundary: NotificationsView remains explicitly unavailable until grouped UI composition

not_delivered: grouped Leptos inbox rendering and hydrated paging state
tenant-wide scheduled reconciliation and payload redaction
search index SEO and deep-link migration
PostgreSQL runtime execution and cross-consumer evidence
